object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: For each kind of data file (manifest, object file, links file, view file, filter file, rules file), add an element the format doesn't define (<extra>x</extra> as a child of the root element) and an XML attribute it doesn't define (extra="1" on the root element and on one child). Read the document. Expected: no load error, and the document reads exactly as the same files without the additions.
